basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Product-Minded AI Engineer | Production LLM Pipelines & Data Agents | Marketing-Tech Systems | 3× Founder
basics.summary: Product-minded AI engineer who ships marketing-tech LLM systems that customers actually use. At LumApps I built the AI-powered outbound platform (multi-agent workflows on Python + LangGraph + GCP Vertex AI, MCP tool servers I authored) backed by AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph unifying Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo and product-usage signals into one customer data layer. 2x conversions, $1M forecast quarterly. Prior LLM shipping at Beekeeper ($337K vendor cost eliminated in 6 weeks, GenAI demo tooling for Sales). Founded 3 AI products solo through Anand Creations, taking each from POC to real users. MBA (93.2%). Remote-native since 2018.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Shipped a production marketing-and-outbound AI platform: multi-agent workflows on Python + LangGraph + Google ADK, tools over MCP servers I authored, agent state streamed live over AG-UI. From POC to full production; 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, $1M forecast quarterly.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti/Neo4j unifying Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo and product-usage signals into one time-aware customer data layer every agent reads and writes. Data agents answer analytics questions in natural language without breaking data trust.

Made the key architecture calls solo: framework choice (LangGraph over vanilla LangChain), memory pattern (temporal KG over vector-only RAG), evaluation gate (golden suites + LangSmith + safety cases). Own reliability and on-call for global production.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Replaced $337K/yr in vendor translation costs with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks (GitHub Actions + OpenAI + LangChain). 12K+ marketing/content assets translated; marketers ship in new languages without a gatekeeper.

Built AI Onboarding Specialist and a GenAI demo generator that auto-composed personalized, on-brand content per account from Salesforce data. Direct marketing-tech impact: improved demo speed and close rates.
Designed a distributed templating engine that cut customer setup time 90% and powers 15% of all assets on the platform (10M+ users). Full-stack, Product Owner; backend architecture at scale.
Ran observability and global on-call (K8s, AWS, Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io, Langfuse). Hired and mentored the AI engineering cohort.

work.name: Dronistics (EPFL spin-off)
highlights: Founding engineer at a startup. Shipped full stack backend + operator UI (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, real-time APIs, AWS/Docker/Terraform) from empty repo to 500+ deliveries. POC-to-production motion is the whole job here.
Direct customer engagement (Unilever partnership, CES showcase). Turned prototypes into signed opportunities.
